title: Generate a real CLI for Skill Creator
description: The current skills repository supplied an existing Skill Creator with real create and validate scripts. lov-cli-creator analyzed that source, generated an installable command, invoked it from an isolated environment, created a new temporary Skill source, and validated the original project through its real backend.
prompt: 参考 CLI-Anything，做一个 lov-cli-creator，接收一个项目路径，默认为 Skill 执行所在路径，输出一个 CLI。

items: Five generated-CLI tests passed and the final CLI validator passed all five checks
Real create workflow produced and read back a complete Skill scaffold
